content.text:
Excellent! All 71 tests pass. I've created the render module:

**New `src/render.js`:**
- **`renderInvoiceText(invoice, customer)`** — generates a plain-text invoice
  - First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued)
  - Second line: customer name
  - One line per invoice item showing: quantity (right-padded), product name, unit price, and line total
  - Last line: total amount
  - All monetary amounts formatted with `formatEuros()` for consistency

**Format example:**
```
INV-2024-0001
Customer: Northwind Studio
  5x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
 10x Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €950.00
  1x Logo package @ €1,200.00 = €1,200.00
Total: €2,575.00
```

**10 new tests** covering:
- DRAFT display for draft invoices
- Invoice numbers for issued invoices
- Customer name display
- All line items shown
- Correct line total calculations
- Euro formatting for all amounts
- Line count verification
- Quantity padding/alignment
- Single-product invoices
- Input object preservation

All amounts shown to users now go through `formatEuros()` — establishing the pattern for all future rendering. ✓
